title: Sales Order Agent for Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Introduction and setup of the sales order agent
Customer scenario - Ian's office furniture request
Agent email engagement and draft response
Quote creation and delivery to customer

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An autonomous agent that processes customer emails requesting quotes and sales orders. The agent maps emails to customer accounts, generates draft responses, creates quotes with product details and pricing, and handles back-and-forth communication with customers.
caveats: Requires user approval before sending email responses
Requires user review and confirmation before quote delivery
Agent can clarify vague customer requirements

features.name: Agent email mapping to customer accounts
features.description: The agent automatically maps incoming customer emails to the correct customer account in Business Central based on email address.

features.name: Agent-generated quote creation
features.description: The agent creates sales quotes with rich details including product selection, SKU mapping, pricing, sales tax, delivery dates, and external purchase order numbers from customer emails.
caveats: Requires user review and confirmation before sending to customer

features.name: Agent setup and configuration
features.description: The sales order agent can be set up in Business Central by adding a shared customer email address, managing user access for approval, and activating the agent with no additional configuration needed.

features.name: Outlook email integration for agent
features.description: The sales order agent integrates with Outlook, where it monitors a shared customer email mailbox and automatically processes incoming customer requests for quotes and orders.

features.name: Agent approval workflow in Business Central
features.description: Users can review and approve agent-generated emails and quotes in Business Central before they are sent to customers. The workflow allows flexible approval - users can check and approve multiple requests at once or approve as replies are generated.
caveats: Requires manual user approval before sending
Team must manage approval frequency and timing
